LanguageData.Gun_USP45_RWP.description: The USP45 is a semi-automatic pistol designed for accuracy and reliability. Chambered in .45 ACP, it delivers substantial stopping power with a moderate fire rate. Ideal for self-defense or as a sidearm in combat, its balance of precision and force makes it a valuable choice for any colonist.
